# ui::KeyEvent

Header: `winui/core/Input.hpp`.

One keyboard event, delivered to the focused element by Window::handle_key().

[Text](../controls/text.md#uitext) input is not a KeyEvent: typed characters arrive separately as UTF-8 text. A KeyEvent carries only the semantic [Key](namespace-ui.md#key) plus the modifier state.

Example: 
```cpp
// In an element of your own, which gets the keys while it has focus:
class EditorControl : public ui::Element
{
protected:
    bool key_override(const ui::KeyEvent& e) override
    {
        if (e.action != ui::KeyAction::Down)
        {
            return false;
        }
        if (e.key == ui::Key::Enter)
        {
            commit();
            return true;
        }
        if (e.key == ui::Key::N && e.modifiers == ui::ModifierKeys{.ctrl = true, .shift = true}) // Ctrl+Shift+N
        {
            new_document();
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

private:
    void commit();
    void new_document();
};

// Or for the whole window, before the focused element sees the key:
ui::Property<std::string> search_text;
window.on_key_preview([&](const ui::KeyEvent& e)
{
    if (e.action == ui::KeyAction::Down && e.key == ui::Key::Escape)
    {
        search_text = ""; // cancel the search
        return ui::Handled; // it goes no further
    }
    return ui::NotHandled;
});
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | `Key` | `Key::Unknown` | The key pressed or released. |
| `action` | `KeyAction` | `KeyAction::Down` | Press (including auto-repeat) or release. |
| `modifiers` | `ModifierKeys` |  | The modifier keys held alongside `key`. Shift extends a [TextBox](../controls/text-box.md#uitextbox) selection and reverses [Tab](../controls/tabs.md#uitab); Ctrl or Alt makes a shortcut. The key combinations the system owns (Alt+F4, Alt+Space, Alt+Tab, Alt+Esc) never arrive. |
